description: Forward Codex lifecycle events to AgentDesk hook executable.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -NoProfile -Command "try { $null = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/health' -TimeoutSec 1 -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output '{}'; exit 0 }; $root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; & \"$root\windows\artifacts\AgentDesk.Hook-win-x64\AgentDesk.Hook.exe\""
